description: Adds the person to a room with a one-line blurb. The room’s other members then see their handle, that blurb and when they joined, and nothing else about them. Joining again replaces the blurb.

blurb.description: One line, in the person's own voice.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: join_room
title: Join a Room
